title: The Gran Sasso laboratory and the Gerda experiment

tellings.quote: It is called the Gerda experiment because they are they didn't find it still find it. The so-called Majorana particle.

plain: A researcher named Filippo Biondi, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, talks about a science laboratory under the Gran Sasso mountains in Italy. He says an experiment there called Gerda is hunting for a particle known as the Majorana particle, and that they still haven't found it.
